outcome: Reference intervals for procalcitonin (PCT) in maternal blood and umbilical cord blood
cohort: 127 healthy Chinese women in late pregnancy (70 vaginal deliveries and 57 cesarean section deliveries)
finding: Maternal blood and umbilical cord blood PCT levels have different reference intervals in healthy Chinese women in late pregnancy.
mod_finding: Cord blood PCT levels did not differ significantly between vaginal and cesarean deliveries.
